summary: This note is a short infobox-style entry for Warner Bros. Records, a record label. It gives the label's founding date (March 19, 1958), founder (James Conkling), and parent company (Warner Music Group). It also lists its distributors by territory, its genre as various, its country of origin as the United States, its location as Burbank, California, and its official website.
one_line: Warner Bros. Records is a United States record label founded in 1958 by James Conkling, owned by Warner Music Group and based in Burbank, California.
key_facts: Warner Bros. Records was founded on March 19, 1958.
James Conkling is listed as the founder of Warner Bros. Records.
Warner Bros. Records has the parent company Warner Music Group.
In the United States, Warner Bros. Records is self-distributed.
Outside the United States, Warner Bros. Records is distributed by WEA International.
Rhino Entertainment Company is the distributor of Warner Bros. Records re-issues.
The genre of Warner Bros. Records is listed as various.
The country of origin of Warner Bros. Records is the United States.
Warner Bros. Records is located in Burbank, California, U.S.
The official website of Warner Bros. Records is warnerbrosrecords.com.
